## Purpose
How far a run has got, from 0 to 100: finished layers plus the running layer's measured share. Null while there is nothing to count yet (no manifest).

## Responsibilities
- `runPercent(run)`.
- `RunProgressBar` shows motion until a manifest arrives. `RunProgressCard` adds the label and note.

## Key elements
`runPercent`, `RunProgressBar`, `RunProgressCard`.
